item.title: WATCH: Dramatic video shows the moment a U.S. fighter jet narrowly dodges an Iranian missile
item.summary: Dramatic video shows the moment a missile came dangerously close to shooting down a F-18 fighter jet over Iran. It comes as Israel announced it killed Iran's navy chief.

item.title: WATCH: US fighter jet in close call with Iranian missile
item.summary: New video shows a U.S. fighter jet narrowly evading an Iranian missile. The close call comes as the Pentagon weighs sending 10,000 more troops to the Middle East.

item.title: WATCH: Urgent search for missing flight attendant
item.summary: The search is underway for an American Airlines flight attendant who has been reported missing in Colombia, according to officials.

item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: Delivery robots slam into Chicago bus shelters, cause damage
item.summary: Two delivery robots are now being blamed for separate incidents which damaged city property. WLS-TV's Karen Jordan reports.

item.title: House Republicans reject Senate DHS funding bill, Trump signs memo to pay TSA workers
item.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson flatly rejected the Senate's bill to fund all parts of the Department of Homeland Security except for ICE.

item.title: WATCH: David Muir shares the memorable moments from MLB Opening Day
item.summary: ABC producer Myra Green escorted her 109-year-old father, who is also a WWII and Korean War veteran, to throw out the first pitch for his favorite team, the Baltimore Orioles.

item.title: WATCH: Melania Trump showcases robot guest at WH summit
item.summary: A walking, talking humanoid robot strolled side-by-side with first lady Melania Trump at the White House for the second day of her international technology summit.

item.title: WATCH: 109-year-old Orioles fan throws first pitch on Opening Day
item.summary: 109-year-old Arthur Green, a World War II and Korean War veteran, threw out the ceremonial first pitch for the Baltimore Orioles on Opening Day.

item.title: Tiger Woods involved in rollover crash in Florida: Sheriff
item.summary: Tiger Woods was involved in a rollover crash in Jupiter Island, Florida, on Friday afternoon, the Martin County Sheriff’s Office said.
